description: Return one Eulerian number A(n,k), counting permutations with exactly k descents.

source.discovery_note: Current OI Wiki algorithm heading only; discovery only, with no code or examples reused.
source.method_reference: Richard P. Stanley, Enumerative Combinatorics, Volume 1, Section 1.4
source.license_note: OI Wiki states CC BY-SA 4.0 and SATA; only the mathematical method idea is used.

input.statistic: k is the number of descents in a permutation of [n]

workspace.meaning: Two fixed 21-entry i64 rows require 336 bytes; the remaining allowance covers scalar bookkeeping.

contract.primary_method: Build each Eulerian row using A(0,0)=1 and A(n,k)=(k+1)A(n-1,k)+(n-k)A(n-1,k-1), with out-of-range entries zero.
contract.independent_method: For n>=1, use the inclusion-exclusion formula sum(j=0..k+1, (-1)^j * binom(n+1,j) * (k+1-j)^n) with arbitrary-precision intermediates; return A(0,0)=1 directly.
contract.complexity: Primary O(n^2) time and O(n) auxiliary space; independent formula uses O(n) big-integer terms.
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, non-exact framing, n outside 0..20, or k outside its n-dependent range returns -1.
contract.distinct_from: Entringer numbers group alternating permutations by first element; graph Eulerian paths/circuits concern edge traversal. This package counts ordinary permutations by descents.

generated_profile.description: A generated complete row at n=20 sums to 20!, bounding every valid output.
